controller.heading: Controller
controller.text: Responsible for the processing of personal data on this website is:

hosting.heading: Hosting and server logs
hosting.text: This website is hosted by [enter hosting provider]. When you open a page, the server processes technically necessary data such as IP address, time, requested address and browser identification to deliver the page and keep the service secure. The logs are deleted after [enter retention period]. The legal basis is Art. 6 (1) (f) GDPR.

storage.heading: Cookies and local storage
storage.text: This website sets a single, technically necessary cookie: “lang” remembers the chosen language for one year. The chosen color scheme is kept in the local storage of the browser and is not sent to the server. Both only come into being once you change the setting. No consent is required for this (§ 25 (2) TDDDG).

thirdParties.heading: Fonts and external content
thirdParties.text: Fonts, scripts and images are delivered from our own server. No third-party content is embedded.

tracking.heading: Analytics and tracking
tracking.text: This website does not use any analytics or tracking services.

mail.heading: Contact by email
mail.text: If you send an email, your details are processed to answer the request. The legal basis is Art. 6 (1) (f) GDPR. The message is deleted as soon as it is no longer needed.

rights.heading: Your rights
rights.text: You have the right to access, rectification, erasure, restriction of processing and data portability, as well as the right to object to the processing. You may also lodge a complaint with a data protection supervisory authority.
